semiconductor_relevance: High — MediaMac Pte Ltd specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor wet processing, making it a relevant supplier in the semiconductor industry.
summary: MediaMac Pte Ltd is an original equipment manufacturer focused on customizable engineering plastic equipment tailored for semiconductor applications. Their offerings include wet processing benches, electroplating lines, and complementary products such as acid exhaust scrubbers and DI water systems, aimed at enhancing process automation and production yield.
